description: Use for 'anything happening on my account list?' or 'what changed at these companies this week?'. Return newly recorded findings for your tracked accounts since a chosen date, with the public event date, the date Intakra recorded it and source links. Defaults to the last seven days. Optional domains restrict the list. Saved findings may describe older events discovered recently. No findings is not proof of no activity. This reads saved records without running new research.

domains.description: Optional company domains to check against your tracked list, up to 200. Omit to use your tracked accounts.

limit.description: Findings to return, default 50. Narrow since or domains if truncated.

since.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone, not in the future. Default: seven days ago.

name: get_account_changes
title: Review changes on your account list
